title: Corporate Cowboy/Amazing patio views of Downtown
description:
The Corporate Cowboy was designed for those who work hard and play hard! This space may be small but it’s big on location, amenities & amazing views of downtown Nashville from the spacious, private 4th floor terrace.  Fast fiber internet with smart tv’s for streaming in both the living room & bedroom. The private bedroom has a luxurious queen adjustable base bed and the living room offers a sleek Murphy bed with a plush full sized mattress for additional guests.
